name: activityView
label: Activity View
description: Toggle to view activities in a stacked, focused or guided view.

name: playbookContextIdsInOrder
label: Playbook Context IDs in order
description: An array of playbook context IDs to determine the order of playbooks.

name: playbooksByContextId
label: Playbook Context ID Map
description: A map of playbooks using the context id of each playbook as the key.

name: playbookExperienceId
label: Playbook Experience
description: Playbook Experience record for all playbooks.

name: selectedItem
label: Selected item
description: Selected playbook item.

name: userSession
label: User Session
description: Contains current user session data.

name: loadingActivities
label: Loading Activities
description: A map of all loading activities.

name: parentRecordUpdateTime
label: Parent Record Update Time
description: Unix timestamp of the playbook's parent record last update.

name: optionalActivityTriggerContext
label: Optional Activity Trigger Context
description: Contains info for adding optional activity triggers.

name: updatedActivities
label: Updated Activities
description: Contains the last updated activities.

name: enableFullWidthCards
label: Enable full-width cards
description: Allow all cards in the playbook to take up the full page width.

name: showFilteredCount
label: Show filtered count
description: Show the filter count when the playbook filter is enabled in the view.

name: daClientActionContract
label: DA client action contract
description: The contract that UI Builder uses to dynamically build the available declarative actions for event mapping.

name: compactMode
label: Compact Mode
description: Flag to determine whether to display in compact mode

name: usingMonolith
label: Using Monolith
description: Flag to determine if being used as part of now-playbook-experience-connected component.

name: hidePriorityIndicator
label: Hide Priority Indicator
description: Flag to determine if priority indicators should be hidden.

name: extraParams
label: Extra Parameters
description: A JSON object containing properties for the activity ui.

name: processDefinition
label: Playbook to launch
description: Process Definition to launch

name: overrideInputs
label: Override inputs
description: Override inputs within playbook

name: playbookLoading
label: Playbook Loading
description: Flag to indicate the data broker is loading
